findings.issue_text: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:534 logs routine successful cleanup batches at Error level with entire ID lists, polluting production error logs and potentially creating very large entries; use Debug/Info and omit the IDs
pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:77 reduces the global cleanup ticker from 10 minutes to 1 minute, running every cleanup task 10× more frequently and increasing database load and contention

goldens.comment: The code uses Error log level for what appears to be debugging information. This will pollute error logs in production. Consider using Debug or Info level instead.

The cleanup job ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which can lead to increased database load and contention due to more frequent execution of cleanup tasks. This change should be reviewed to ensure it aligns with performance expectations.
